title: IRCTC Cancellation Charges 2026: Refund Rules by Class, Waitlist, Tatkal and TDR
seoTitle: IRCTC Cancellation Charges 2026: New Refund Rules
seoDescription: IRCTC cancellation charges from April 2026: flat fee over 72 hours, 25% at 72-24 hours, 50% at 24-8 hours, no refund within 8 hours. Waitlist, Tatkal, TDR.
excerpt: Worked refund examples for confirmed, waitlisted and Tatkal tickets, the class-wise minimum charges, how the earlier reservation chart changes your deadline, and when a TDR still gets your money back.
